description: bin/lib/contact-email.ts contactEmail() is the one resolver of the polite-pool contact email (D-19-09): it reads the variable named by [network] contact_email_env (default PENSMITH_CONTACT_EMAIL), honours a configured name only when it is an upper-case identifier containing EMAIL or MAILTO (a paper's config travels with the paper and must not aim pensmith at a secret), and sends a value only when it looks like an email. A second reader of process.env.PENSMITH_CONTACT_EMAIL or of the config's contact_email_env would ignore the configured variable or skip those checks. http.ts's User-Agent, the OpenAlex / Unpaywall / retraction-lookup parameters and the doctor probe all call contactEmail().
